priority_decision.rationale: A bounded 21-item source scope addresses uncovered school/art/laboratory objects and words, readable child-to-parent classification gaps, a Romanian landscape term, and common nominative/plural inputs such as avioane, mănăstiri and cinematografe. The attention pass checked 637 surfaces against current owners and reviewed stock; most familiar alternatives were already covered, held or lacked truthful graph closure. Sixteen new-concept hypotheses each have four distinct actual current-main endpoints and at least two unchanged same-category endpoints, with no batch peers. Five existing-owner families preserve exact current owners; Rudă is a number-form hypothesis under Rude and Cântec already exists as an active Melodie alias. School/category terms are source graph vocabulary only, never automatic hidden targets or playable rounds. This is an eligible smaller wave; no weak forms or invented links fill a 40-item quota.
priority_decision.existing_stock_priority: Assess reviewed stock and an actually uncovered high-value gap offline; proceed immediately to eligible next source wave under owner continuous authority, otherwise propose curation without quota padding.
priority_decision.backlog_extension: Extend discovery with middle-school language units, concrete laboratory/drawing/projection objects, collective or taxonomic source parents and familiar missing singular/plural families. Full planned-family/sense/owner/hold screening precedes any web request; qualified Bloc de desen requires component morphology plus separate compound-sense evidence. Keep the large reviewed stock uninstalled and preserve every excluded lexical/owner-attention backlog item.
